personalInfo.title: Senior Full Stack Developer & AI/IoT Systems Engineer

summary: Senior Full Stack Developer & AI/IoT Systems Engineer with 10+ years building scalable enterprise systems. I bridge hardware and software—from ESP32 firmware to cloud microservices—creating AI-driven automation with IoT ecosystems. Currently at Idol Technology LLC (Dubai, UAE), architecting production-ready systems that blend AI-driven automation with IoT ecosystems.

experience.description: Architected and deployed IdolMEA ERP system driving digital transformation for 50+ retail branches across the GCC. Developed IdolQueue (i-QMS) using Flutter and Node.js with offline-first architecture. Implemented AI-powered chatbot automation for WhatsApp/Telegram. Integrated YOLO object detection for AI Self-Checkout Kiosk (showcased at Gitex Dubai 2024). Engineered 8+ node WireGuard VPN mesh on MikroTik routers.

Led development of SincA ERP platform (Flutter + Node.js + Python AI backend). Implemented AI-powered dashboards and predictive analytics. Developed OCR invoice parsing system with 95% accuracy. Built automated WhatsApp/Telegram bots for customer interaction. Managed cross-location developer teams with hybrid CI/CD pipelines.

Developed comprehensive ERP, accounting, and billing systems using WPF (C#) with MVVM architecture. Built admin portals and reporting dashboards. Created inventory management and POS systems for retail clients.
